shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({version:p.version,dependencies:p.dependencies,scripts:p.scripts},null,2))\"
rg -n \"ajv|specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation|validated by|test-commands\" src specs .lore package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,100p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,190p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,100p' tsconfig.json
sed -n '1,100p' tsconfig.build.json
sed -n '1,90p' CHANGELOG.md
node -p \"require('ajv/package.json').version\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface Options|strict\\??:|interface ErrorObject|type ErrorParameters\" node_modules/ajv/dist node_modules/ajv/lib | head -60
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts | sed -n '30,110p'
rg -n \"function create|lastMessage|if \\(round\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"console.log(require('ajv/package.json').types, require('ajv/package.json').exports)\"; sed -n '1,55p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts; sed -n '1,35p' node_modules/ajv/dist/jtd.d.ts; rg -n \"ToolResultMessage|interface ToolResultMessage\" src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"\\(\\[validated by|specs/.+#\" src/orchestration src | head -30
rg -n \"test\\('.*\\[|it\\('.*spec\" src | head -30
rg -n \"re-lint/max-comment|doc comment|hal-engine-tool-input\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo yes || echo no; rg -n "reanchor|repoint" scripts | head'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test tools reject wrong input types" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
